G4:LA4 Minimum notice periods regarding operational changes, including 
whether these are specified in collective agreements.
column5:
We provide advance notice in accordance with local requirements in the  
different locations where we operate. We also have regular quarterly meetings 
with all employees via webcast, provide information on business changes as  
soon as possible, and take steps to mitigate negative impacts. We do not have 
collective agreements.
